source_repair.summary: Controlled observations establish normal Druid HP2/MP4, normal Monk HP3/MP3 and normal Paladin HP3/MP3 in both hungry and fed states. Approximate HP intervals4s/3s fed and mana6s/5s fed match official intervals. Fourteen regeneration fields, party activity timeout and initial stamina debit remain unresolved; no extrapolation or runtime selection. Food observations and owner choices are preserved.
